entities.name: Óndra Łysohorsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Óndra Łysohorsky was the pseudonym of Ervín Goj, a Czech poet of Silesian origin and awareness. He is known for his works written in the Lach dialects, which he helped to systematize as a literary language. He also wrote in German; Friedrich Hölderlin was a large influence on his writing.
